description: Get the full details of one data model by id or slug: complete field definitions (type, options, relations, validation) the product capability config (enabled, field roles incl. the resolved `roles`, variantAxes) the accounts config (`auth`: identityField, companyField - a relation to a Company model; each field's `memberCanSet` says whether the member may change it on their own account and send it at sign-up, never for password fields or the company field) the Company capability (`company`: { enabled }, null when never set; a model is at most one of product, account or company) and `urlPattern`, the storefront route its records' `url` is built from (null when none). Use before update_model and when the user asks about a model's structure.

idOrSlug.description: The model's id or slug (from list_models)

name: get_model
title: Get model
